instruction: Hide .vscode folders from the VS Code file explorer.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VS Code to exclude .vscode folders from the file explorer. Evaluator verifies that the settings.json file contains the correct files.exclude configuration for .vscode folders. Uses custom check_json_settings metric with nested dict subset checking.
